capabilities.title: Preserved reproducible baseline
capabilities.basis: Pinned main and exact-head CI/artifacts exist. Acceptance/handoff documentation includes historical candidate states.

capabilities.title: Versioned evidence and domain contracts
capabilities.basis: Versioned asset/event/finding/scene/agent contracts exist; temporal identity/control/response domains need expansion.

capabilities.title: Complete installation and discovery pack
capabilities.basis: Manual manifest/Compose, generic ingest, SDK, Falco HTTP and OTLP JSON exist; automated cloud discovery packs do not.

capabilities.title: Historical capability coverage
capabilities.basis: Current source health is explicit; historical capability/configuration/loss intervals are not available.

capabilities.title: Namespaced temporal identity graph
capabilities.basis: Stable graph IDs and temporal fields exist; raw actor/session/run correlation still needs issuer/namespace semantics.

capabilities.title: Faithful semantic world
capabilities.current_main_status: implemented redesigned core; broader world proposed
capabilities.basis: Four workspaces, ten modules, LOD, grouped scenes and recovery exist; 28-surface semantic world is not implemented.

capabilities.title: Artifact-to-runtime lineage
capabilities.current_main_status: not implemented as a verified chain
capabilities.basis: Pipeline asset/declared deploy edges are not source-build-digest-runtime provenance.

capabilities.title: Conditional exposure and path analysis
capabilities.basis: Graph traversal and typed relationships exist; effective conditional permission/exposure solving does not.

capabilities.title: Contextual vulnerability applicability
capabilities.basis: No reviewed SBOM/feed/applicability pipeline is present in the baseline.

capabilities.title: Exact investigation retrieval
capabilities.current_main_status: implemented core; revision and capacity gaps
capabilities.basis: Exact evidence retrieval and search exist. Historical bundle pinning and measured scale remain.

capabilities.title: Case and hypothesis workspace
capabilities.basis: Finding-centric investigations/notes/exports exist, but no independent persistent case/hypothesis domain in the reviewed schema.

capabilities.title: Agent intent/decision/execution/effect telemetry
capabilities.basis: Tool invocation and effect events exist. Complete intent/decision/execution/effect instrumentation is not established.

capabilities.title: Scoped MCP and coding workflow
capabilities.basis: Read-mostly stdio MCP with event tools and target posture exists; actual change diff and continuous subscriptions are separate work.

capabilities.title: Control inventory and independent tests
capabilities.basis: No complete control inventory and independently verified behavior-test lifecycle.

capabilities.title: Pre-change security diff
capabilities.basis: Current-target findings/coverage assessment exists, not analysis of candidate code/config/artifact diffs.

capabilities.title: Credential aftermath and residual access
capabilities.basis: No supported credential/descendant authority investigation and provider recheck pack.

capabilities.title: Deception placement and trigger evidence
capabilities.basis: Decoy-use events and detections exist; registered placement/propagation/provider lifecycle is missing.

capabilities.title: Defense laboratory and scenario packs
capabilities.basis: Synthetic fixtures/reference app/browser tests exist; operator-facing defense lab and full scenario packs are missing.

capabilities.title: Exact response-plan authorization
capabilities.basis: Human-typed-token decisions exist, not real-person/plan-digest/expiry/precondition execution authorization.

capabilities.title: Optional isolated executor
capabilities.basis: No executor. Preserve this boundary until separate gated implementation.

capabilities.title: Independent containment/recovery verification
capabilities.basis: No provider-action/effect/residual-access recovery verification workflow.

capabilities.title: Operational and security foundation
capabilities.current_main_status: substantial single-node foundation; incomplete team operations
capabilities.basis: Durable journal, source auth, redaction, quarantine, replay/recovery tests exist; SSO, broader operations and independent review remain.

capabilities.title: Measured scale and federation
capabilities.basis: SQLite and bounded windows; no proven HA/team-scale/federation capability.

capabilities.title: Extensible open-source ecosystem
capabilities.basis: Apache-2.0, contribution docs and original kit exist; pack ecosystem/release conformance and broad adoption need development.
